details.format: GAM length-prefixed records and FE RLE
details.pixel_aspect: 2:1 for ANTIC E bitmap and single-width player previews
details.palette_note: PAL RGB visualization; original GTIA bytes retained. Contextual palettes without evidence use grayscale.
notes: One room uses flag $13; this is valid under the original numeric and parity tests.
The 36 base-scene previews include an explosion-animation background and a retail-version purchase notice; this is not a count of playable rooms.
Groups 1/2 on side one are program data; groups 19/20 are game state, not graphics.
Inventory groups 21/23 contain nine independent 512-byte collections.
